Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Patent Counsel – Nutrition & Health at Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., your mission is to enable and protect science-driven innovation in Medical Nutrition through pragmatic legal services and business-focused intellectual property protection. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, project leaders, Research and Development management, business stakeholders and Legal colleagues across Vevey, Konolfingen and global Research and Development locations. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Nutrition & Health

• Partnering with Medical Nutrition teams to identify, protect and leverage innovations that improve outcomes for patients and consumers.

• Developing intellectual property strategies that support category priorities, business objectives and long-term innovation leadership.

• Building robust protection plans for strategic projects across the full innovation lifecycle.

• Managing patent drafting, filing and prosecution activities worldwide to create value and protect Nestlé’s competitive advantage.

• Delivering patentability, freedom-to-operate and competitor intelligence insights that help teams make confident innovation decisions.

• Contributing to partnerships, licensing, due diligence, oppositions and litigation matters where intellectual property expertise is critical.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong patent expertise and the ability to create practical protection strategies for science-driven innovation.

• Applying advanced scientific knowledge in fields such as food science, nutrition, biochemistry, biotechnology, life sciences, chemistry, pharmaceuticals or health sciences.

• Using strategic judgement to manage patent portfolios across multiple jurisdictions with a focus on value creation, risk management and cost efficiency.

• Collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams, external patent firms and senior stakeholders in an international environment.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value. We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Tipo di contratto / durata: Contratto permanente

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Consulente Brevetti – Nutrizione e Salute presso Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., la vostra missione è quella di attivare e proteggere l'innovazione scientifica nella nutrizione medica attraverso servizi legali pragmatici e la protezione della proprietà intellettuale focalizzata sul business. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, leader di progetto, gestione della ricerca e dello sviluppo, stakeholder aziendali e colleghi legali in Vevey, Konolfingen e sedi globali di ricerca e sviluppo. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fornire risultati significativi che fanno la differenza in scala.

Come farai un impatto come consulente brevetti – Nutrizione & Salute

• Collaborare con i team Medical Nutrition per identificare, proteggere e sfruttare le innovazioni che migliorano i risultati per i pazienti e i consumatori.

• Sviluppare strategie di proprietà intellettuale che supportano le priorità di categoria, gli obiettivi aziendali e la leadership di innovazione a lungo termine.

• Costruire robusti piani di protezione per progetti strategici in tutto il ciclo di vita dell'innovazione.

• Gestire le attività di redazione, archiviazione e persecuzione dei brevetti in tutto il mondo per creare valore e proteggere il vantaggio competitivo di Nestlé.

• Fornire informazioni sull'intelligence di brevettabilità, libertà e concorrenza che aiutano i team a prendere decisioni di innovazione fiduciose.

• Contribuire a partenariati, licenze, due diligence, opposizioni e controversie in cui l'esperienza di proprietà intellettuale è critica.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte esperienza di brevetto e la capacità di creare strategie di protezione pratica per l'innovazione basata sulla scienza.

• Applicare conoscenze scientifiche avanzate in settori come scienza alimentare, nutrizione, biochimica, biotecnologia, scienze della vita, chimica, farmaci o scienze della salute.

• Utilizzando il giudizio strategico per gestire portafogli di brevetti in più giurisdizioni con un focus sulla creazione di valore, la gestione del rischio e l'efficienza dei costi.

• Collaborare efficacemente con team multidisciplinari, aziende di brevetti esterni e stakeholder senior in un ambiente internazionale.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso. Ci proponiamo di assumere persone amichevoli, rispettose e stimolanti che si preoccupano della vita della gente che tocchiamo ogni giorno.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid / Vollzeit, 100%

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als Patentberaterin für Ernährung und Gesundheit bei der Société des Produits Nestlé S.A. ist es Ihre Mission, wissenschaftsgetriebene Innovationen in der medizinischen Ernährung durch pragmatische Rechtsdienstleistungen und unternehmensorientierten Schutz des geistigen Eigentums zu ermöglichen und zu schützen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Projektleitern, Forschungs- und Entwicklungsmanagement, Geschäftsinteressenvertretern und Rechtskollegen in Vevey, Konolfingen und globalen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsstandorten zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und sinnvolle Ergebnisse zu liefern, die einen Unterschied in der Größenordnung machen.

Wie Sie als Patent Counsel Einfluss nehmen werden - Ernährung & Gesundheit

• Zusammenarbeit mit Teams von Medical Nutrition, um Innovationen zu identifizieren, zu schützen und zu nutzen, die die Ergebnisse für Patienten und Verbraucher verbessern.

• Entwicklung von Strategien für geistiges Eigentum, die Kategorienprioritäten, Geschäftsziele und langfristige Innovationsführerschaft unterstützen.

• Aufbau robuster Schutzpläne für strategische Projekte während des gesamten Innovationslebenszyklus.

• Verwaltung von Patententwürfen, Einreichung und Strafverfolgung weltweit, um Wert zu schaffen und den Wettbewerbsvorteil von Nestlé zu schützen.

• Patentierbarkeit, Betriebsfreiheit und Insights für Wettbewerber, die Teams dabei helfen, selbstbewusste Innovationsentscheidungen zu treffen.

• Der Beitrag zu Partnerschaften, Lizenzen, Due Diligence, Einsprüchen und Rechtsstreitigkeiten ist von entscheidender Bedeutung.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Einbringen einer starken Patentexpertise und der Fähigkeit, praktische Schutzstrategien für wissenschaftsgetriebene Innovationen zu entwickeln.

• Anwendung fortgeschrittener wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse in Bereichen wie Lebensmittelwissenschaft, Ernährung, Biochemie, Biotechnologie, Biowissenschaften, Chemie, Pharmazeutika oder Gesundheitswissenschaften.

• Strategisches Urteilsvermögen zur Verwaltung von Patentportfolios in mehreren Ländern mit Fokus auf Wertschöpfung, Risikomanagement und Kosteneffizienz.

• Effektive Zusammenarbeit mit multidisziplinären Teams, externen Patentfirmen und hochrangigen Stakeholdern in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Fließend Englisch kommunizieren; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen. Unser Ziel ist es, freundliche, respektvolle und inspirierende Menschen einzustellen, die sich um das Leben der Menschen kümmern, das wir jeden Tag berühren.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Vevey, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein, 100%
Type / durée du contrat : Contrat permanent

Être une force pour le bien et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète

En tant que conseiller en brevets – Nutrition et santé à la Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., votre mission est de favoriser et de protéger l'innovation scientifique en nutrition médicale par des services juridiques pragmatiques et la protection de la propriété intellectuelle axée sur les entreprises. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec les scientifiques, les chefs de projet, la direction de la recherche et du développement, les intervenants commerciaux et les collègues juridiques de Vevey, Konolfingen et les sites mondiaux de recherche et de développement. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de produire des résultats significatifs qui font la différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que conseiller en brevets – Nutrition et santé

• Établir des partenariats avec des équipes de nutrition médicale pour identifier, protéger et exploiter les innovations qui améliorent les résultats pour les patients et les consommateurs.

• Élaborer des stratégies de propriété intellectuelle qui appuient les priorités des catégories, les objectifs opérationnels et le leadership à long terme en matière d'innovation.

• Élaborer des plans de protection robustes pour les projets stratégiques tout au long du cycle de vie de l'innovation.

• Gérer les activités de rédaction, de dépôt et de poursuite des brevets dans le monde entier pour créer de la valeur et protéger l'avantage concurrentiel de Nestlé.

• Fournir la brevetabilité, la liberté d'exploitation et des renseignements sur les concurrents qui aident les équipes à prendre des décisions d'innovation confiantes.

• Contribuer aux partenariats, aux licences, à la diligence raisonnable, aux oppositions et aux litiges où l'expertise en propriété intellectuelle est essentielle.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise en matière de brevets et la capacité de créer des stratégies pratiques de protection pour l'innovation axée sur la science.

• Appliquer des connaissances scientifiques avancées dans des domaines comme les sciences alimentaires, la nutrition, la biochimie, la biotechnologie, les sciences de la vie, la chimie, les produits pharmaceutiques ou les sciences de la santé.

• Utiliser le jugement stratégique pour gérer les portefeuilles de brevets dans plusieurs administrations, en mettant l'accent sur la création de valeur, la gestion des risques et l'efficacité des coûts.

• Collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, des entreprises de brevets externes et des intervenants de haut niveau dans un environnement international.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; d'autres langues sont un avantage.

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu, tout en traduisant les idées en un impact mesurable et en créant une valeur partagée. Nous visons à embaucher des personnes amicales, respectueuses et inspirantes qui se soucient de la vie des gens que nous touchons chaque jour.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à être une force pour le bien?

Appliquer maintenant et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète.

jobs.title: Associate Robotics Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based, full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As an Associate Robotics Specialist at the Nestlé Deep Tech Center , your mission is to help identify, evaluate, develop and deploy advanced robotics and intelligent automation solutions that turn emerging technologies into scalable manufacturing solutions. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project teams, research and development centers, engineering hubs, factories, pilot plants, quality labs, suppliers, system integrators, universities and technology partners. This is your opportunity to accelerate Nestlé’s innovation mission and deliver meaningful results that shape the future of food at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Robotics Specialist

• Building and applying robotics expertise to unlock smarter, safer and more efficient manufacturing solutions.

• Scouting and evaluating emerging technologies that can become practical, scalable automation concepts.

• Supporting robotics projects from early opportunity framing through proof of concept, pilot and industrial deployment.

• Delivering work packages across requirements, design reviews, commissioning, start-up and qualification with a focus on quality, safety and reliability.

• Translating validated concepts into maintainable automation solutions that can be reused across different use cases and environments.

• Sharing knowledge, documentation and training content that strengthens adoption and builds robotics capability across our community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing hands-on knowledge of robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial artificial intelligence or advanced engineering projects.

• Applying practical exposure to robotics integration, end-of-arm manipulation, mobile robotics, machine vision, sensors or robot safety.

• Using programming, data analysis, simulation or digital twin tools to support robust technical recommendations and solutions.

• Collaborating across technical and operational teams with proactivity, autonomy, comfort with ambiguity and a strong focus on safety and quality.

• Communicating confidently in English and presenting technical ideas clearly to diverse audiences; French is a plus.

• Thriving in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment and being ready to move fast from concept to reality, while translating ideas into measurable impact

At Nestlé Deep Tech Center, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

Nestlé is an inclusive employer and, if needed, we are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout your journey with us. All information is treated confidentially.

Our workplace is fully barrier free with step free access, elevators to all floors, and accessible restrooms. We also maintain a strong safety culture, supported by modern installations and procedures to ensure a secure environment for everyone.

Our hiring process typically includes application review, a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications on a rolling basis and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Ubicazione: Orbe, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: Office-based, a tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Data di inizio: appena possibile

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

Come Associate Robotics Specialist presso il Nestlé Deep Tech Center , la vostra missione è quella di aiutare a identificare, valutare, sviluppare e implementare soluzioni avanzate di robotica e automazione intelligente che trasformano le tecnologie emergenti in soluzioni di produzione scalabili. Si farà la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con team di progetto, centri di ricerca e sviluppo, hub di ingegneria, fabbriche, impianti pilota, laboratori di qualità, fornitori, integratori di sistema, università e partner tecnologici. Questa è la vostra occasione per accelerare la missione di innovazione di Nestlé e fornire risultati significativi che modellano il futuro del cibo in scala.

Come farete un impatto come Specialista Robotica Associata

• Costruire e applicare competenze robotiche per sbloccare soluzioni di produzione più intelligenti, più sicure e più efficienti.

• Esplorare e valutare le tecnologie emergenti che possono diventare concetti pratici e scalabili di automazione.

• Sostenere i progetti di robotica dall'inquadratura precoce delle opportunità attraverso la prova del concetto, della distribuzione pilota e industriale.

• Fornire pacchetti di lavoro in base a requisiti, recensioni di progettazione, messa in servizio, start-up e qualificazione con un focus sulla qualità, sicurezza e affidabilità.

• Tradurre concetti convalidati in soluzioni di automazione mantenibile che possono essere riutilizzati in diversi casi di utilizzo e ambienti.

• Condivisione di conoscenze, documentazione e contenuti formativi che rafforza l'adozione e costruisce la capacità robotica in tutta la nostra comunità.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare la conoscenza pratica di robotica, automazione, meccatronica, intelligenza artificiale industriale o progetti di ingegneria avanzata.

• Applicando l'esposizione pratica all'integrazione della robotica, alla manipolazione dell'estremità del braccio, alla robotica mobile, alla visione della macchina, ai sensori o alla sicurezza dei robot.

• Utilizzando programmi, analisi dei dati, simulazione o strumenti gemelli digitali per supportare raccomandazioni e soluzioni tecniche robuste.

• Collaborare tra team tecnici e operativi con proattività, autonomia, comfort con ambiguità e una forte attenzione alla sicurezza e alla qualità.

• Comunicare con fiducia in inglese e presentare idee tecniche chiaramente a pubblico diverso; il francese è un plus.

• Promuovere in un ambiente fortemente collaborativo e innovativo e essere pronti a muoversi velocemente dal concetto alla realtà, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile

Al Nestlé Deep Tech Center, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with pilot plant teams, scientists, engineers, quality and safety specialists, technical experts and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP)

• Leading pilot-scale bioprocess trials that help transform promising research into scalable manufacturing solutions.

• Driving fermentation process development by optimizing media, feeding strategies and key operating parameters for reliable performance.

• Developing downstream processing approaches that improve yield, recovery and product quality.

• Building process understanding through data analysis, automation insights and digital tools that support optimization and reproducibility.

• Contributing to safe, compliant and high-quality pilot plant operations through risk assessment, documentation and continuous improvement.

• Shaping the development of new biotech pilot plant capabilities by translating process needs into practical equipment and facility solutions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in fermentation, bioprocessing and pilot or industrial-scale operations.

• Applying scale-up, technology transfer and industrialization knowledge to make processes robust and ready for implementation.

• Using analytical thinking, process data and automation tools to troubleshoot, optimize and improve reproducibility.

• Collaborating across research, engineering, operations, quality and safety teams with ownership and a hands-on mindset.

• Communicating confidently and delivering presentations in French or English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, Bioprozessing-Aktivitäten zu leiten, die die Entdeckung im Labormaßstab und die industrielle Fertigung durch robuste Fermentations- und Downstream-Verarbeitungslösungen verbinden. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Pilotanlagenteams, Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsspezialisten, technischen Experten und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP) etwas bewirken

• Führende Bioprozessversuche im Pilotmaßstab, die dazu beitragen, vielversprechende Forschung in skalierbare Fertigungslösungen umzuwandeln.

• Förderung der Entwicklung von Fermentationsprozessen durch Optimierung von Medien, Fütterungsstrategien und wichtigen Betriebsparametern für eine zuverlässige Leistung.

• Entwicklung nachgelagerter Verarbeitungsansätze, die den Ertrag, die Rückgewinnung und die Produktqualität verbessern.

• Aufbau eines Prozessverständnisses durch Datenanalyse, Automatisierungseinsichten und digitale Tools, die die Optimierung und Reproduzierbarkeit unterstützen.

• Beitrag zu einem sicheren, konformen und qualitativ hochwertigen Pilotbetrieb durch Risikobewertung, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

• Gestaltung der Entwicklung neuer Biotech-Pilotanlagen durch Umsetzung der Prozessanforderungen in praktische Ausrüstungs- und Anlagenlösungen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen starker Expertise in den Bereichen Fermentation, Bioverarbeitung und Pilot- oder Industriebetrieb.

• Anwendung von Scale-up, Technologietransfer und Industrialisierungswissen, um Prozesse robust und bereit für die Implementierung zu machen.

• Mit analytischem Denken, Prozessdaten und Automatisierungstools zur Fehlersuche, Optimierung und Verbesserung der Reproduzierbarkeit.

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen Forschungs-, Ingenieur-, Betriebs-, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsteams mit Eigenverantwortung und einer praktischen Denkweise.

• Vertrauensvoll kommunizieren und Präsentationen in Französisch oder Englisch halten.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant at Nestlé Product Technology Centre, your mission will be to maximize the effectiveness of the R&D Centre Head and leadership team by acting as a trusted support partner in a high-exposure position.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant

• Act as a trusted support partner to the NPTC Head and Leadership Team, enabling strategic focus and effective decision-making.

• Manage complex calendars, priorities and schedules, anticipating conflicts and ensuring timely preparation and follow-up.

• Prepare agendas, minutes, action tracking and key documents with accuracy, structure and confidentiality.

• Support newcomer onboarding and communication to help them navigate the organization.

• Provide autonomous support on audits, reporting, follow-ups and ad hoc operational priorities.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience in a senior administrative, executive assistant, coordination or project support role within an international, matrixed and fast-moving organization.

• Strong ability to manage complexity, anticipate needs, prioritize competing demands and keep senior stakeholders aligned and informed.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, especially Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams, with confidence in preparing high-quality documents, presentations and simple data follow-ups.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt messages for different senior stakeholders; French and/or German would be an asset in this multi-site environment.

• A proactive, resilient and solutions-oriented mindset, demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with the NHW, Research and Development, IT teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

• Leading nutrition data analysis to support portfolio decisions.

• Building automated dashboards and reporting capabilities that improve accuracy, efficiency and visibility across global nutrition data.

• Driving data quality, validation and audit readiness to strengthen confidence in internal and external nutrition reporting.

• Developing digital prototypes and new automated functionalities that make nutrition reporting and benchmarking faster, smarter and easier to use.

• Delivering data-driven knowledge projects with clear plans, strong governance and high-quality scientific outputs.

• Nurturing cross-functional networks to understand business needs, share ideas and build digital nutrition capabilities at scale.

• Master's degree in a relevant field such as data science, statistics, nutrition, food science or equivalent.

• Bringing strong data analytics skills, ideally applied to nutrition, food data or scientific reporting.

• Proven previous experience, preferably in a food manufacturing or recipe management environment.

• Applying knowledge of recipe management, food regulations, nutrition labelling and data governance to create reliable outputs.

• Using data analysis, visualisation, database querying or programming tools to translate complex data into clear insights.

• Collaborating across functions, influencing with integrity and managing projects to deliver meaningful outcomes.

• Communicating with working proficiency in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Patent Specialist Nutrition & Health at Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., your mission is to help identify, protect and manage innovations emerging from Nestlé’s research and development activities. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with patent counsels, scientists, innovation teams, legal experts and business partners across Nutrition & Health. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Specialist Nutrition & Health

• Supporting the protection and management of Nutrition & Health innovations across the patent lifecycle, from invention capture to portfolio maintenance.

• Contributing to patentability assessments, prior-art searches and freedom-to-operate activities that guide research and business decisions.

• Preparing patent landscape and competitive intelligence insights that strengthen understanding of the external innovation environment.

• Collaborating with scientists, inventors and innovation teams across Nestlé Research and Nutrition & Health research and development.

• Assisting with patent filing and prosecution activities in partnership with experienced patent counsels and external patent attorneys.

• Building practical intellectual property expertise through mentoring, hands-on learning and exposure to multidisciplinary innovation projects.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a strong scientific foundation in life sciences, nutrition, food science, biochemistry, biotechnology, chemistry, pharmacy, health sciences or a related discipline.

• Applying analytical thinking to understand complex technologies and translate scientific information into clear patent-related insights.

• Using your interest in intellectual property, innovation and patent protection to learn quickly and contribute with curiosity and precision.

• Collaborating proactively with scientists, inventors, patent professionals and business partners while managing multiple priorities with attention to detail.

• Communicating fluently in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Résumé du poste

En tant qu’Ingénieur·e projet chez Nestlé Suisse S.A., ta mission est de préparer et réaliser des projets d’investissement industriels, de l’étude initiale à la mise en service. Tu feras la différence en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de production, de sécurité, de finance, d’achats ainsi qu’avec les fournisseurs et partenaires externes. Ce rôle clé te permettra de connecter avec des spécialistes, de développer ton expertise et de créer un impact pour la fabrique.

Ton impact en tant qu’Ingénieur·e projet

• Piloter des projets d’investissement industriels de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en service, dans le respect des délais, des coûts, du périmètre, de la qualité et de la sécurité.

• Concevoir des solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de la fabrique pour des installations telles que tuyauteries, pompes, équipements de production et lignes de conditionnement.

• Élaborer les études, les estimations budgétaires, les plannings et les demandes d’investissement afin de sécuriser les décisions et la réalisation des projets.

• Anticiper les risques techniques, opérationnels et liés au chantier, puis mettre en place les mesures nécessaires pour protéger les personnes, les équipements et la continuité des opérations.

• Coordonner les fournisseurs, les achats, les essais chez les fournisseurs et les travaux sur site, tout en assurant le suivi des permis de travail, de l’installation et des coûts.

• Conduire la mise en service, la formation des équipes et le transfert aux opérations afin d’assurer une montée en performance durable des nouvelles installations.

Ce qui fera ta réussite dans le rôle

• Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent (génie mécanique, électrique, des procédés, industriel ou similaire)

• Apporter une expertise en gestion de projets d’investissement dans un environnement industriel, idéalement dans l’agroalimentaire.

• Appliquer une approche structurée pour maîtriser les délais, les coûts, le périmètre, les risques et la gestion du changement.

• Utiliser ton jugement technique pour analyser les besoins, établir des estimations et faire avancer les décisions avec autonomie.

• Communiquer de manière proactive, transparente et adaptée avec les équipes internes, les fournisseurs et les partenaires de chantier afin d’anticiper les difficultés et de maintenir l’alignement de toutes les parties prenantes.

• Communiquer couramment en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

• Faire preuve de courage, de collaboration, de réactivité et de curiosité.

Chez NCH, nous plaçons les personnes au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous offrons un ensemble d’avantages compétitif et complet, conçu pour soutenir ta croissance et ton bien-être au travail comme dans ta vie personnelle :

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Participation aux frais de santé et programme d’aide aux employés pour toi et ta famille

• Forte contribution de l’employeur à ton plan de prévoyance

• Congé parental généreux et solutions complètes de soutien à la famille

• Opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement pour faire grandir tes compétences

• Remises attractives pour les employés sur des produits et services du quotidien

Ce à quoi t’attendre dans notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse, et nous sommes disponibles pour mettre en place des aménagements raisonnables si nécessaire. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une forte culture sécurité, avec des installations modernes et des procédures visant à garantir un environnement sûr pour toutes et tous.

Le processus de recrutement comprend généralement un premier échange avec la recruteuse, un entretien avec le responsable de l’équipe pouvant inclure une étude de cas ou une visite du site, puis un entretien final axé sur les comportements avant une éventuelle offre. Riepilogo del post

In qualità di Ingegnere di Nestlé Svizzera S.A., la vostra missione è quella di preparare e realizzare progetti di investimento industriale, dallo studio iniziale alla messa in servizio. Si farà la differenza lavorando a stretto contatto con ingegneria, produzione, sicurezza, finanza, team di approvvigionamento e fornitori esterni e partner. Questo ruolo chiave vi permetterà di connettervi con specialisti, sviluppare le vostre competenze e creare un impatto per la fabbrica.

Il tuo impatto come progetto ingegneristico

• Progetti di investimento industriali pilota dalla definizione della necessità di commissionare, in tempo, costi, perimetro, qualità e sicurezza.

• Soluzioni tecniche di progettazione adattate alle esigenze della fabbrica per impianti come tubi, pompe, attrezzature di produzione e linee di imballaggio.

• Sviluppare studi, stime di bilancio, la pianificazione e le richieste di investimento per garantire le decisioni e l'attuazione del progetto.

• Anticipare i rischi tecnici, operativi e legati al sito e poi mettere in atto le misure necessarie per proteggere le persone, le attrezzature e la continuità aziendale.

• Coordinare i fornitori, l'approvvigionamento, il collaudo dei fornitori e il lavoro in loco, mentre il lavoro di monitoraggio consente, l'installazione e i costi.

• Conduce la messa in servizio, la formazione del team e il trasferimento alle operazioni per garantire un aumento sostenibile delle prestazioni di nuove strutture.

Che renderà il vostro successo nel ruolo

• Laureato in ingegneria o equivalente (meccanico, elettrico, processo, ingegneria industriale o simile)

• Fornire competenze nella gestione di progetti di investimento in un ambiente industriale, idealmente nel settore agroalimentare.

• Applicare un approccio strutturato per gestire il tempo, i costi, la portata, i rischi e la gestione dei cambiamenti.

• Usa il tuo giudizio tecnico per analizzare le esigenze, fare stime e spostare le decisioni in avanti con autonomia.

• Comunicare in modo proattivo, trasparente e appropriato con team interni, fornitori e partner di costruzione per anticipare le difficoltà e mantenere l'allineamento di tutte le parti interessate.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese e francese, sia per via orale che per iscritto.

• Mostra coraggio, collaborazione, reattività e curiosità.

A NCH, mettiamo le persone al cuore di tutto quello che facciamo.

Offriamo un pacchetto competitivo e completo di benefici progettati per sostenere la vostra crescita e il benessere sul lavoro e nella vostra vita personale:

• 5 settimane di vacanza

• Spese di assistenza sanitaria e programma di assistenza ai dipendenti per voi e la vostra famiglia

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere le tue competenze

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti sui prodotti e servizi quotidiani

Cosa aspettarsi nel nostro processo di reclutamento

Siamo impegnati a fornire un'esperienza di reclutamento inclusiva e rispettosa, e sono disponibili per fornire un alloggio ragionevole, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con strutture e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di reclutamento di solito include uno scambio iniziale con il reclutatore, un'intervista con il team leader che può includere un caso di studio o visita del sito, e poi un'intervista finale basata sul comportamento prima di una possibile offerta. Esaminiamo le domande mentre progrediscono e chiudiamo la posizione non appena un solido elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato; Incoraggiamo pertanto i candidati ad applicare il più presto possibile. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Summary of the post

As a Engineer at Nestlé Switzerland S.A., your mission is to prepare and implement industrial investment projects, from initial study to commissioning. You will make the difference by working closely with engineering, production, security, finance, procurement teams and external suppliers and partners. This key role will allow you to connect with specialists, develop your expertise and create an impact for the factory.

Your Impact as a Engineer Project

• Design technical solutions adapted to the needs of the factory for installations such as pipes, pumps, production equipment and packaging lines.

Which will make your success in the role

• Provide expertise in managing investment projects in an industrial environment, ideally in the agri-food sector.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager within our global M&A team, you will play a key role in shaping and executing strategic corporate projects that support the long-term growth of the Nestlé Group. Leading acquisitions, divestments, joint-ventures and other high-impact initiatives, you will ensure strong governance, rigorous valuation, and effective negotiations that create value and manage risk. Working closely with Zone and SBU leadership, Market Heads and CFOs, senior management, and specialist internal and external partners, you will help turn strategic opportunities into measurable business impact on a global scale, working across categories and geographies.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager

• Partner with Zones and Strategic Business Units to shape M&A strategies and evaluate potential acquisition or divestment opportunities.

• Lead end-to-end acquisition and divestment processes, ensuring projects follow the appropriate governance and approval requirements.

• Assess financial, strategic, and operational risks and opportunities to strengthen decision-making and negotiation positions.

• Lead negotiations on transaction agreements to optimize value and manage risk for Nestlé.

• Provide timely, clear, and decision-relevant information to senior management throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate internal specialists and manage relationships with investment banks, financial advisers, accounting advisers, legal counsel, and other external partners to ensure the timely completion of projects.

• Extensive experience in mergers and acquisitions or in leading complex projects within a multinational organization, consultancy, investment bank, or financial advisory environment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, businesses, and geographies.

• Fluency in English, with additional languages considered an advantage, combined with flexibility, sound judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.
